newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber ups Bay on stronger rentals.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber ups Bay on stronger rentals.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc said on Wednesday its upgrade of Bay Apartment Communities Inc reflected a stronger rental market.

Analyst Jonathan Litt said in a report the ratings boost to buy from attractive came because the company was "the best-positioned multifamily real estate investment trust to show strong, sustainable growth."

Bay Apartment's funds from operations during the third quarter rose 20 percent from the corresponding period a year ago. Same-property rental revenues and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization rose 11.8 percent and 16 percent, respectively, from the year-ago quarter.
The company's stock was up 5/8 to 30 in late-afternoon trade.
